obligations.source_text: Create an independently invented, visibly testable complex photographic scenario using the attached adult appearance reference, with the randomized variation seed interpreted as a wind-driven coastal salvage operation.

bindings.rolloff_anchor_phrase: one bright diffuse surface or specular highlight provides a clear near-white anchor across wet bronze, white foam, and reflective rock pools
bindings.rolloff_shoulder_phrase: luminance approaches white through a gradual shoulder with several distinguishable bright steps across foam, metal reflection, and cloud sheen
bindings.rolloff_clip_phrase: any fully clipped white area stays confined to a small specular or source core inside the bell reflection, with surrounding bright detail remaining visible
bindings.rolloff_texture_phrase: surrounding highlight texture subtle hue and midtone separation remain visible across salt-stained bronze, wet orange fabric, blue glass, foam, and rock
bindings.rolloff_boundary_phrase: the smooth highlight shoulder is not replaced by flat low contrast underexposure glow gray highlights or local HDR halos; edges around the bell, foam, hair, sailcloth, and beacon remain naturally separated
